name: Japanese battleship Nagato

sources.title: Japanese battleship Nagato — capsized and sank on the night of 29/30 July 1946 after the Baker test; the wreck upside down, her four propellers its most prominent feature at 33.5 m
Bikini Atoll dive tour — Nagato: upside down in 170 ft, hull and propellers at 110 ft, the bridge accessible at 150 ft

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1291512_nagato.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Upside down at about 52 m, resting on her deck edge with the turrets and upperworks crushed down into the bottom; the four great propellers and the rudder uppermost; the pagoda bridge broken off and lying on its side beside the hull. The heading (not published: 0), the state of the turrets and the place of the pagoda are approximate. model_built.glb: the battleship as she was in 1946. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
